message.content: {"memo": "The filing reports net loss of $80,748m for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The size mainly reflects change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs of $72,388m for the six months ended June 30, 2026. It also reflects other income (expense), net expense of $8,757m for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
